notes: Assumptions that move the number: brown rice raw weight (300 g = 1101 kcal, 46 % of the total); half a medium pineapple ≈ 325 g flesh; light soy sauce as regular shoyu; both tbsp of oil eaten. No added sugar: the sweetness is pineapple and 100 % juice. Cross-check: lighter sweet-and-sour pork recipes list ~400–450 kcal for the stir-fry alone; adding 75 g raw brown rice (~275 kcal) gives ~650–700, so 600 is within range (this version has lean fillet and little oil).
